readings.E1: calendar = D26's dates from T0 to END; the three D25 index files are sliced to [T0, END] on read (Smallcap 100 as text lines, so no earlier row is parsed); rows on dates D26 lacks (Saturday special sessions) are dropped and counted; every session must have a bar in all three files (asserted)
readings.E2: decision dates = T0 and the last D26 session of every later ISO week; the decision at the last session (END) is made and not traded
readings.E3: label = latest Master row dated <= decision date, per index and for MAUc1 (D24b); IN iff all three index SIGN are BUY; g = BUY iff the MAUc1 SIGN is BUY (a week whose row is dated after its last D26 session reads the previous week's row); the Smallcap 100 Master rows are sliced to >= T0 on read (the whole xlsx is parsed, rows before T0 are dropped at once and never used)
readings.E4: initial position at T0's close, no cost: IN = the three index positions at the book's weights of NAV 1 (units w_i / close_i); OUT = gw GOLDBEES and (1-gw) cash of NAV 1 with gw = 0.8 (g BUY at T0) or 0.2 (SELL), 0.5 in fixed50 mode
readings.E5: index fill = OHLC4 of the D25 bar (close if any of open/high/low is blank; none is); valuation = close
readings.E6: quarterly reset: a session t > 0 whose month is Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct and whose previous session is in another month; it trades iff the book holds the proxy at the START of the session (the position left by the previous trade) and no decision trade falls on t (an exit or entry session does that trade only); no reset while OUT, none in `every` (constant mix) runs because their weekly rebalance already resets; END's session is a reset session when it opens a quarter (2019-01-02) and is traded: only DECISIONS at END are not traded
readings.E7: costs: one rule for every trade, see the module docstring (cost = ow x value traded at the pre-cost targets, then every target scaled by (V-cost)/V; T06/T08's `trade`, unchanged in its arithmetic). T09.md section 3 step 6 says the post-cost targets 'solve the fixed point exactly'; the engine does what T06 and T08 do (this reading is reported)
readings.E8: GOLDBEES leg: close = D09b's close before 2014-07-01 chained with D09's from 2014-07-01; fill = D09b's OHLC4 before 2014-07-01 (the proxy is MAUc1 itself); from 2014-07-01 T03's de-spike (OHLC4 of open/high/low clipped to MCX gold's range that day + 0.5% of the close) with the MCX range read from D24b's daily file; a session with no MCX bar is filled at the raw OHLC4 (counted); a session with no gold bar of its own uses the previous close and fill (counted)
readings.E9: cash level: the extended LBES (D11) as-of on sessions; R2 'liq' = the desk's liquidEtfFinal (LIQUIDCASE) levels as-of on sessions over the whole window (LBES equals LIQUIDCASE until 2024-01-24, so the daily-return difference is reported and should be about zero); no cash is accrued past a file's end (asserted)
readings.E10: constant mix: index share f = invested decision weeks / decision weeks, rebalanced at every decision date's next session (T0 included); constant_mix splits the non-index share 50/50, constant_mix_timed by the decision's gw; initial holding = the proxy scaled by f
readings.E11: single-index comparators: the book with weight 1 on one index, always in, no resets, entry free, so cost never matters
readings.E12: R3 window starts at the first D26 session on or after 2012-01-02 with its own spells and totals (in-or-out and gold), its own bounds, own draws (same seeds) and a free initial position in the state decided then
readings.E13: R7(a): the rule with the GOLDBEES fill on sessions before 2014-07-01 replaced by the proxy's close; R7(b): the rule with the sleeve's gold weight 0.5 for decisions dated before 2014-07-01 and the timed weight from then on (the first decision after 2014-07-01 that sees a different weight trades the sleeve if OUT)
readings.E14: F1 and F2 are run with the 50/50 sleeve at all three costs (R1 needs A1/A2 at 0 and 50 bps; T09.md section 3 step 11 says 'also run with the sleeve fixed at 50/50' without naming the costs); the R2 and R3 cells also run the fixed50 rule and F1 fixed50
readings.E15: bounds of every series: lo = min(2, shortest spell of the state), hi = longest spell of the state, computed from the series in the run and asserted equal to the numbers of tests/T09/logs/step_1_spell_counts.json (the frozen section 2 values)
readings.E16: the four books have identical decision and gold series and share the draws (states are generated once and stored under each book's key)
readings.E17: sessions_invested = number of daily returns t = 1..T-1 earned while the proxy is held (state j is held from its trade session dec_idx[j]+1; T0 for j = 0) (T06-1, unchanged)
readings.E18: the number of sleeve trades of a draw (draws.csv sleeve_trades) is counted from the states: decisions j >= 1 with a trade session inside the window, OUT at j-1 and j, g changed; 0 in fixed50 mode
readings.E19: trades.csv drops T08's basket_eff column (no baskets); `quarterly_reset` is a trade kind; positions.csv and proxy_units.csv hold the unit counts after each trade
readings.E21: V5(a) self-test seed: T06/T08's [6, 123456789] (the test is of the sampler code, which is unchanged; its result there was p = 0.83); a second run with seed [12, 6, 123456789] is reported beside it (p = 0.0031 in the first smoke run: above the 0.001 line, low but ordinary for one test); both must exceed 0.001
readings.E20: no published-NAV file is read (R8 was declined): there is no g_engine.csv and the V4(d) always-in check against a published NAV does not exist; V4 is the identities of T09.md section 2
